fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Per-environment scoping key (project id). Set at creation time from the active env context; legacy rows missing this are filtered out of the scoped Issue Tracker view.

fields.name: envSlug
fields.description: Per-environment scoping key (canonical or custom env slug: dev/stg/prod/uat/<custom>). Set at creation time from the active env context.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display label for the credential (e.g. 'QA Account').

fields.name: email
fields.description: Login email — free-form; not validated server-side.

fields.name: passwordMasked
fields.description: Display-only masked string (•'s). The real password never leaves the user's browser today; only the masked echo is persisted. See spec section 12.3.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: true | false. Stored as a string because Blocks Data schema fields are primitives — the adapter coerces to boolean. Disabled secrets are skipped by the walker's scope gate; mirrors VerificationTarget.enabled.

fields.name: environmentId
fields.description: Owning Environment.ItemId — env identity for scoping, stamped from the resolved env row at creation. envSlug remains the display cache. requiredOn None until migration backfills, then tightened to Both.
